svg.title: Amazon AI book copycat report and takedown, based on Cam Wilson's account
svg.desc: A three-step evidence flow: journalist Cam Wilson found a suspicious lookalike listing, purchased and inspected the 89-page paperback, then reported it to Amazon, which removed the listing. The seller and generation method were not publicly identified.
svg.text: A lookalike listing. A physical copy. A takedown.
What ABC reporter Cam Wilson documented—and what the public record leaves unknown.
Seller identity and the specific generation method were not established in the reporting.
